pr_title: slice mirroring controller should mirror annotations (except endpoints.kubernetes.io/last-change-trigger-time annotation) and labels
pr_body:
Add support to the endpoint slice mirroring controller to mirror
annotations, in addition to labels.

Also, fix a bug in the endpointslice mirroring controller, that
wasn't updating the mirrored slice with the new labels, in case
that only the endpoint labels were modified.

Fixes #98026

```release-note
The endpointslice mirroring controller mirrors endpoints annotations and labels to the generated endpoint slices, it also ensures that updates on any of these fields are mirrored. 
The well-known annotation endpoints.kubernetes.io/last-change-trigger-time is skipped and not mirrored.
```

issue_context.title: EndpointSliceMirroring controller does not mirror annotations from endpoints
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


**What happened**:
The [endpointslice mirroring controller](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/tree/master/pkg/controller/endpointslicemirroring) does not copy over annotations from endpoints resources to endpointslice resources (although it does [mirror endpoint labels](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/93442)). Additionally, annotations applied by hand to endpointslices owned by the endpointslice mirroring controller are overwritten by the mirroring controller when the corresponding endpoint is modified. Essentially applying persistent custom annotations to endpointslices resources mirrored from endpoints is not possible to my understanding.

**Anything else we need to know?**:
It is unclear to me whether or not this functionality is intentional. Since labels are mirrored, I don't see any harm in annotations being mirrored as well (or at least having the endpointslice mirroring controller permit custom annotations on it's owned endpointslice resources, rather than remove them when syncing endpoints). Note that as is, the [endpointslices KEP](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-network/0752-endpointslices#mirroring-details) does not mention annotations when describing the responsibility of the endpointslice mirroring controller.

**Environment**:
- Kubernetes version (use `kubectl version`): 1.20

Should the `endpoints.kubernetes.io/last-change-trigger-time` annotation be skipped here? (see https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/controller/endpointslice/utils.go#L284)

That's a good question. I think we should _probably_ remove that annotation. There is always a chance that whoever is writing the custom endpoints this controller is mirroring is also setting this annotation correctly. I think there's a somewhat higher probability that this annotation will get stuck with a stale value that is never updated after a Service transitions to an empty selector. The [code that we're relying on for TriggerTimeTracker](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/d70ee902fddc682863a3cc4f0d8eac0223ebf70b/pkg/controller/util/endpoint/trigger_time_tracker.go#L84) just doesn't make sense for custom endpoints, so I think it would be good to omit the annotation.

Somehow I'd thought we already had a helper func for this but I can't find it. We do have an [identically named function in admission](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/plugin/pkg/admission/podnodeselector/admission.go#L263) though...
yeah, there is no good library to deal with annotations and labels, labels have some utils, maybe is a good first issue to create this in apimachinery tools

+                               // ep.Annotations["foo2"] = "bar2"
